policy: append corrections; original R04 reports are preserved unedited

corrections.prior_claim: JQ credential locator documented on the desktop, therefore the source is available
corrections.correction: a known credential location and a non-empty file are not live authentication. The credential file documents a locator; only the R05 bounded live run establishes current authentication, and only for that one request.

corrections.prior_claim: current_proof_count=4 counted as current supplier proof
corrections.correction: withdrawn. Local file access, static configuration, historical supplier proof and current bounded supplier proof are now four separate classes with separate counts.

that interpreter is the known-broken desktop binding. Package directories existing inside it do not make the interpreter runnable. Every executable example must use the dedicated working interpreter runtime\.venv\Scripts\python.exe.

corrections.prior_claim: blackbox_full_data_update_scope_refresh_r1.py can be used as a read-only scope inspection
corrections.correction: it is a writer. Its body calls wjson(SCOPE, new) and then writes a child CURRENT summary. It must not be run as an inspection step.

corrections.prior_claim: an old summary HIST_END/asof is the runtime download target
corrections.correction: a summary asof is not runtime authority. The existing daily invariant states RUN_TARGET_TRADE_DATE is the only runtime target and that legacy HAND finance_asof_target/stock_asof_target cannot override it. Latest-data updates must not be frozen to an old CURRENT asof.

corrections.prior_claim: ACCESS_EVIDENCE EV-05: 'CLEAN (and therefore CACHE)' lacks 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-01
corrections.correction: the 'and therefore CACHE' inference is withdrawn and replaced with a direct observation: the 2026 partition of both STOCK_DAILY_RAW_PIT_R1 and STOCK_DAILY_PIT_R1 returns exactly 0 rows on both dates, while 2026-08-28 has 5,212 rows and 2026-09-02 has 5,215 rows. The CLEAN observation is unchanged and was independently re-confirmed.

corrections.prior_claim: QMT live only / not a history source, stated as a supplier limitation
corrections.correction: the exclusion is policy scope for this task, not a demonstrated supplier limitation. No claim is made about QMT history capability in either direction.

corrections.prior_claim: R04-C06: no conversion code exists in the candidate adapter
corrections.correction: overstated. The candidate adapter has a conversion body behind a quarantine. Disabled and unverified is not the same as not implemented, and it stays disabled.
evidence: candidate/r5/engine_adapter.py (unchanged from R04) — quarantine present, not enabled

corrections.prior_claim: retrieving or invoking the generated helper candidate means the engine is ready
corrections.correction: retrieval and invocation are not formal engine readiness. The R05 API result is a function-path harness only: FUNCTION_PATH_TESTED=true, FULL_PACKAGE_STARTUP_NOT_TESTED=true, MASTER_ADMISSION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED=true.

corrections.prior_claim: the CLEAN omission had no identified mechanism
corrections.correction: observed mechanism now evidenced at release-graph level: three consecutive tip releases were parented to the same older release and each added only its own unit, so a sibling's unit is never carried forward. Numeric proof and per-release parent ids are in GAP_REPAIR_INPUTS.json.
